note: Damage done back to attackers by class abilities and buffs, from the beta client's spell tables (build 1.60.1.70291, tools/apply_reflect.py) unless a field says otherwise. Retribution Aura ranks are [level learned, base damage per hit taken, spell id]; retCoef is the share of the paladin's Holy spell damage added to it (retCoefSrc says where it comes from). Blessing of Sanctuary is not in the Forever client at all. Improved Retribution Aura (spells 20091/20092) still has spell rows in the client, but no Forever talent teaches it, so nothing raises Retribution Aura's damage.

PALADIN.retCoefSrc: Blizzard's development notes, 8 October 2026 (the client's spell rows carry no ratio)

holyShield.note: Damage per blocked attack, plus coef x spell power. block is the block chance the client spell adds (30%); the Forge's talent text reads 20%, transcribed from demo footage.

redoubt.note: A 10% chance on a damaging melee hit taken (client spell 20127) to raise block chance; the buff (spell 20128) lasts dur seconds or charges blocks. The block chance per rank comes from the talent text: the client scales it through curve tables our datamine does not have (spell 20128 carries 30, the top rank).

eyeForAnEye.note: Percent of a critical strike's damage dealt back, capped at 50% of the paladin's health. From the talent text: the client spell 9799 still carries Classic's 15% and the per-rank curve is not in our datamine.
